verdict.rationale: Before a run, Consensus lets researchers pick depth by choosing Deep Search for more comprehensive reviews across many studies. They can set scope with filters for study type, year, journal, open-access status and discipline, and with Medical Mode. Nothing in the pack shows explicit effort controls or any way to steer a run while it is executing. Missing for 10: mid-run steering or redirection, explicit effort/budget controls, detailed docs on configuring Deep Search depth, and independent hands-on corroboration.
